name: VenueOps — Venue Hire & Booking Manager
description: A booking manager for halls, studios and community spaces: manage spaces and hirers, take bookings, plan setups, record payments, and log incidents and damage. Includes 6 forms and 1 app.

packMeta.name: VenueOps — Venue Hire & Booking Manager
packMeta.description: Run a hire venue — halls, studios, sports courts and meeting rooms: list your spaces, take bookings, plan room setups, record payments and log incidents or damage, all linked together.
packMeta.author: FormLogic

forms.title: Space
forms.description: List a hireable space with its capacity, hourly rate, features and availability status.

fields.label: New Space
fields.description: Add a space to the catalogue so it can be priced, booked and tracked.

properties.placeholder: e.g. Main Hall, Studio 2, Court A

forms.title: Client
forms.description: Add a hirer with their organisation and contact details.

fields.label: New Client
fields.description: Capture the hirer details so bookings and payments stay linked to the right person.

properties.placeholder: Regular hire nights, access requirements, invoicing preferences…

forms.title: Booking
forms.description: Take a booking for a space with the date, times, purpose, status and hire amount.

fields.label: New Booking
fields.description: Book a space for a client with the date, times and purpose of the hire.

forms.title: Setup Requirement
forms.description: Plan the room setup for a booking: layout, equipment, catering and completion status.

fields.label: Setup Sheet
fields.description: Tell the crew how the room should be set before the doors open.

properties.placeholder: Head table at the north end, aisle down the middle, urn on at 6pm…

forms.title: Incident & Damage Report
forms.description: Log damage or an incident against a booking with a cost estimate and status.

fields.label: Incident & Damage Report
fields.description: Record what happened so damage gets assessed, costed and closed out.

properties.placeholder: What happened, where in the venue, and who was involved…

forms.title: Payment
forms.description: Record a payment against a booking with the amount, date, method and status.

fields.label: Record Payment
fields.description: Log money received against a booking so the ledger stays current.

apps.name: VenueOps
apps.description: A venue hire hub: list your spaces, take and confirm bookings, plan room setups, collect payments and log incidents — with the whole diary on one dashboard.

roles.name: Venue Manager
roles.description: Full access to every VenueOps form.

roles.name: Bookings Coordinator
roles.description: Front desk staff who answer enquiries, take bookings and record payments.

roles.name: Facilities Crew
roles.description: Setup and maintenance crew who prepare rooms and report damage.

reports.name: Bookings
reports.description: Total number of bookings taken across the venue.

reports.name: Bookings by purpose
reports.description: What the venue gets hired for, by booking purpose.

reports.name: Revenue
reports.description: Total payment value recorded across all bookings.

reports.name: Bookings by space
reports.description: Which spaces get hired the most, grouped by the linked space.

reports.name: Incidents by type
reports.description: Incident and damage reports broken down by type.

reports.name: Venue operations overview
reports.description: A one-page summary of hire activity, revenue and incidents across the venue.

blocks.title: Venue operations overview
blocks.body: This report summarises hire activity across the venue: how many bookings are on the books, what the venue gets hired for, which spaces earn their keep, the revenue collected, and the incident picture. Use it for committee meetings, owner updates and seasonal planning.
